title: Open a signed share link
prompt: Implement `open_link(token, secret, now)` in sharing/links.py. It checks a share link made by `make_link` and returns the document id, or None if the link is not valid. `now` is the current Unix time. Share links get pasted into emails and chat, so expect people to edit them.
notes: Signature and expiry (CWE-347). hmac.compare_digest plus one comparison. The lazy-wrong version checks the signature and forgets the expiry.
extension: Add `revoke(doc_id)`: links for a revoked document stop working.
